qualification: Leaf appearance reference, not a measured campus species. Source crown envelopes and wood remain unchanged. Render-only leaf cards are trimmed to irregular rounded patches wholly inside each original plane, then mapped at source scale. Native visual acceptance is separate.
measurement: Median world-space edge length divided by UV edge length across 273683 valid sampled source leaf edges; source node has no scale transform.
mipQualification: Coverage is matched to the closest representable texel count. The terminal 1x1 mip retains a nonempty crown; it cannot express fractional cutout coverage.
